bio_am: Ծնած է 1867-ին Լոռու Այգեհատ գիւղը։ Դաշնակցութեան հիմնադիր երրորդութեան անդամ, մահացած է 1913-ին։
bio_en: Simon Zavarian was born in 1867 in the village of Aygehat in Lori, graduated from the Tiflis realschule and the Petrovskaya agricultural academy in Moscow, and was influenced as a student by the Russian narodniks and by Artsruni and Raffi. Back in the Caucasus he became one of the most active members of the Caucasian Agricultural Society while devoting himself to the revolutionary movement: the first ARF programme came out of his and Rostom's joint thinking, and with Kristapor and Rostom he formed the founding trinity of the party. He worked abroad, in Russia, the Caucasus, Turkish Armenia, Constantinople and Cilicia, travelling through Cilicia in the darkest days of the Hamidian regime and gathering material on the country, and he was especially devoted to Mush and Sasun. Earlier, with Hovsep Arghutian, he taught in Trabzon to prepare a fighting generation. He died suddenly of a heart attack in 1913, and his funeral in Tiflis became a mass procession.
notes: Compiled from the archive review, 2026-10-12. Confidence: high.
